park.required: Power isolated; REMOVE ENTIRE spindle/split-clamp module or entire plasma-drop/head/torch module before moving any cassette. Only the common Zadapter remains. Remove eightM6 clamp sets into owned tool storage; retain Z; open door. Install next tool module only after bed conversion.
